title: Claim
description: GENERATED from schema/contracts/claims.py. The unit an agent may assert; numbers must cite fact_ids.

DerivedBy.description: Who produced a Claim. `code` claims may carry numbers computed in calc/.
DerivedBy.title: DerivedBy

Evidence.description:
A verbatim quote from a source, string-matched by the verifier.

The quote must appear in the text behind `source_id` after whitespace
normalization, or audit/ raises IssueType.UNSUPPORTED_CLAIM.
Evidence.title: Evidence

Trend.description: Whether a finding reflects a durable change or a passing one.
Trend.title: Trend

Unit.description: Unit of a ValueObject. `fraction` is never a percent (0.25 means 25%).
Unit.title: Unit

allOf.title: status ok requires a numeric value
status ok requires a source_id or a non-empty derived_from
status unavailable requires a null value

ValueObject.description:
Every reported or computed financial number in the system.

Fractions, not percents. Money in full USD. Missing data is
{"value": null, "status": "unavailable"} - never 0, never "N/A", never an
omitted key.

A value computed in code from facts has type "fact" and lists `derived_from`.
Discount rate, terminal growth and exit multiples are "assumption".
Consensus numbers and scenario outputs are "estimate".

value.description: The number in full units, or null when status is unavailable.
value.title: Value

source_id.description: Where the number came from. Required unless derived_from is set.
source_id.title: Source Id

derived_from.description: Dotted paths or fact_ids this value was computed from.
derived_from.title: Derived From

ValueObject.title: ValueObject

ValueStatus.description: `unavailable` is the ONLY way to express missing data. Never 0, never "N/A".
ValueStatus.title: ValueStatus

ValueType.description:
Epistemic status of a number, rendered as a colour in the report.

fact       reported in a filing, or computed in code from reported values
estimate   a forecast: consensus, or a scenario output
assumption a chosen constant: discount rate, terminal growth, exit multiple
ValueType.title: ValueType

VerificationStatus.title: VerificationStatus

value.description: The number this claim is about, when it is about a number.

fact_ids.description: Facts this claim rests on. REQUIRED whenever a number appears.
fact_ids.title: Fact Ids

section_ids.description: Filing sections this claim rests on. REQUIRED for qualitative claims.
section_ids.title: Section Ids

evidence.description: Verbatim quotes. The verifier string-matches each one.
evidence.title: Evidence

derived_by.description: code = computed in calc/, agent = asserted by an LLM, filing_text = lifted from a filing.
